title: Trump's EPA is paving the way for haze to return to national parks, conservationists warn
description: Conservationists are warning that the Trump administration is working state by state to undo decades of progress in clearing skies over the country's beloved national parks. A federal regulation known as the regional haze rule established a goal of attaining natural visibility conditions in the parks by 2064. The regulation requires each state to submit a plan every 10 years to limit emissions. Federal regulators announced last year that they planned to scale back the rule. Meanwhile, conservationists say the Environmental Protection Agency is approving weak state plans and walking back standards for determining whether pollution-reduction technology is needed at power plants.
